admission.justification: The canonical ruling explicitly weighed building, deferring or declaring needless the parent wake; the chosen event-based observer constrains future host integration.

alternatives.option: Build the observer in the product server plugin on native host events
alternatives.reason: The host exposes the event and timeline; product-owned metadata can give a parent one wake without polling or copying agent prose.

alternatives.option: Defer the silent-turn rule to another task
alternatives.reason: The necessary host event already exists, so the declared fallback condition is not met.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The host ceases to expose the required native events or an explicitly approved new requirement defers the rule.

alternatives.option: Treat the wake rule as needless
alternatives.reason: Silent idle turns strand parent-owned work and the rule explicitly requires the wake.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The owning requirement explicitly removes the silent-turn obligation.

consequences: Use the product plugin/client, start-published role/task/report metadata and the turn timeline. Send fixed nonsemantic lines only, defer while parent/children are active or permission-waiting, and preserve acceptance authority. Decision tests are not the deferred after-landing live observation.
context: The parent wake rule was omitted on the inference that no observation surface existed, while the host plugin interface actually supplies native turn-end and permission lifecycle events.
